developments.reason: Reviewed Wren's round-8 request (Cultivate meadow roots: a learnable, feasible way to propagate and tend edible meadow roots, with unknown inputs and costs) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 3): a general cultivation operation with modes plant, tend, inspect and end; a hand planting trial of one whole owned root in two rounds and 3 energy (1.5 per completed round) that first prepares and records the site and then transfers the root after revalidating location, occupancy and input; a 0.2-energy probe inspection; tending only when a real input and effect are implemented, otherwise refused before costs; production only from a coded establishment and growth rule, otherwise a planting and monitoring precursor. Inspecting the handlers grounded the propagule question: the existing seed dispersal in open-ecology.ts turns one actual stock unit of any living plant (growth interval > 0, fish excluded) into a seedling 'seed or vegetative propagule' with stock 0, a stock ceiling of min(4, parent capacity), the parent's growth interval and a first dispersal 600 rounds later, which establishes and grows under the same rule as natural plants. A whole harvested unit is therefore a supported propagule and production is grounded, so this is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release. Implemented cultivate-plants@1 in scope long-ex16 (learning 3; the ability serializes to 3,025 code units). Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1) whose origin is a living plant of the same food; x, y name a 0.25 m plot in reach on hand-workable ground (the existing long-planting-site rule: ordinary soil, no water or wet bank, waterlogging at most 0.1, clear of people and reserved objects) with soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and fewer than 3 plants of that food or prepared plots within 5 m (the dispersal law's own conditions). Every check runs before any cost, so a refusal spends nothing. Round 1 (1.5 energy) escrows the unit, still owned, carried and ageing, and creates the prepared plot (cultivation-site-prepared). Round 2 (1.5 energy) rechecks reach, site, unit and energy, moves the unit with its origin, mass and age into the plot as an unowned reserved stack that cannot be eaten or used, records its condition at transfer, and gives the plot exactly the seedling data the dispersal law gives a natural propagule (cultivation-propagule-planted; no food is created). The plot then gains establishment only from actual temperature, light, soil moisture, waterlogging and season. At the existing threshold (12, or 60 for woody plants) the unit is absorbed into the new plant: it leaves the food stocks and its mass is recorded (cultivation-plot-established). Stock then grows by one unit per growth interval up to the ceiling (cultivation-crop-matured at the first unit) and is harvested only through unchanged gather. If the buried unit spoils first under the existing ageing law, the plot dies, stops growing and is no longer a food source (cultivation-trial-failed). An unworked round, too little energy, leaving reach or a changed site pauses without charge (cultivation-work-paused). Plant resumes the person's own unfinished work and pays only the remaining round (cultivation-work-resumed). End takes one round and no energy, acts only on the person's own unfinished work, returns the unit once in its current condition and clears the empty site (cultivation-trial-ended). Death before transfer leaves the unit where the person died. A transferred unit stays planted, and nothing is refunded. Inspect (one round, 0.2 energy) runs the baseline probe observation on a plot or plant source in reach and adds an unverified personal record of visible lifecycle, stage, stock, soil and weather (cultivation-condition-observed). Verified findings come only from the probe's existing dated-change rule, which deduplicates across probe and cultivation. Tend is refused before any cost. This scope has no carried water, fertilizer or soil amendment, no input can change a plot's moisture, and crowding affects only dispersal, so no treatment input or effect exists and treatment_applied is never emitted. Also not implemented: destructive sampling of a planted specimen (the probe's material modes need an owned unreserved stack and measure load, water or heat response, not viability, and digging up a buried unit is not represented; a unit can still be probed before planting), a stressed label, and any satisfaction. The planting event carries no qualified flag, so no practice milestone, short pleasure or care satisfaction is awarded, and planting or failure gives no nutrition or comfort. Modeling assumptions: a whole harvested unit of a living plant is that plant's propagule, as in the dispersal law, for every food with a growth cycle and an ageing lifetime (so the root and berry, and also nuts, fruit, tubers and fungi). Hand preparation is limited to ordinary soil and needs no tool. The site conditions are the dispersal law's. Hand-loosened soil is not a lasting represented state, so ending or failing before transfer leaves no object. Water and nutrients are represented only by the growth rule's climate moisture, soil moisture, waterlogging and depletion terms, with no separate ledger. The plot keeps the source's growth interval and a stock ceiling of at most 4. A dead plot stays as an empty marked position. Plants that an established plot later disperses are ordinary plants. Reuse is recorded in the package: ex15 cultivation-trial@1's law constants, treated-unit list, ageing, plant, observation-input, footprint and reach helpers through new exports that leave ex15 behavior unchanged (ex7-ex15 replay compatibility identical), and its cultivation-trial drawing; also the unchanged open-ecology.ts growth law, forest-environment.ts ageing, long-planting-site.ts, collective-work.ts escrow and paid work, open-foundation.ts probe and personal records, and base gather. Tests cover learning, the paid rounds, conservation, establishment equal to a natural control seedling, absorption, stock and gather, rot failure, cost-free refusals, pause, resume and planter-only end, inspection, another food (berry), dispersed offspring and death.

Reviewed Sol's round-21 request (Build a small branch windbreak: learn a feasible method for a stable, modest, open-woven branch windbreak beside an outdoor resting place, with unknown materials and costs, avoiding people and living trees) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 4): a general branch-screen construction operation with modes assess, assemble, inspect, repair and dismantle for an unroofed, about 0.9 m wide, 0.40-0.45 m high porous woven screen from three uprights and eight flexible rods, reusing base gather for acquisition, with deterministic suitability, work, stability, damage and exposure, wind effects only on a measured small leeward footprint from current wind, height, porosity and integrity, or else an unverified screen, and no shelter, roof, rain, warmth, comfort or reward bonus. The specification is self-consistent and every dependency exists or could be bounded here, so this is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release. Implemented branch-screen@1 in scope long-ex16 (learning 4; the ability serializes to 3,453 code units). Assess (x, y, orientation; the screen line within reach; 1 round, 0.2 energy, probe-compatible observation) checks a 1.2 x 0.6 m footprint centred on the line (inside the world, ordinary soil, waterlogging at most 0.1, no hazard, overlapping no plant, object, site, entrance or person) and the 0.9 x 0.9 m lee floor (inside the world, not water, no solid object or site), and reports current wind and rain, the facing for the orientation, the 11-unit recipe and the person's usable branch units (branch-screen-assessed, unverified personal record). Assess with post (an owned, unreserved whole branch unit; 1 round, 0.5 energy) is the physical support trial at x, y: on ordinary soil with waterlogging at most 0.1, no hazard and branch strength at least 0.3 the post goes 0.25 m in by hand and holds, and stays owned and unchanged; elsewhere the trial records the measured refusal; a post below condition 0.5 breaks and one unit becomes an owned damaged stack with its mass kept (branch-screen-trial, unverified record); no support or structure is made and the probe sample is untouched. Assemble (x, y, orientation, materials: exactly 11 owned untreated or sound recovered whole branch units) requires mastery, the person's own passing trial inside the footprint, a passing site check and 1.5 energy; it reserves the units through collective-work escrow with exact source provenance (still carried, owned and ageing; branch-screen-started), creates the screen object as a non-solid planned line, and pays 8 rounds of 1.5 energy (12 energy): two seating the uprights at -0.45, 0 and +0.45 m along the line (0.25 m insertion), four weaving two rods each, one gap/alignment round and one stability check, each moving the escrowed units into the screen with origin, mass and age (branch-screen-progress). The check (upright seating: all three uprights at condition at least 0.5 in ordinary soil, waterlogging at most 0.1, no hazard, branch strength at least 0.3; weave retention: all eight rods at condition at least 0.5 and branch flexibility at least 0.2) either completes the screen (branch-screen-completed) or leaves it unstable without shielding (branch-screen-check-failed). An unworked round, too little energy, leaving reach, a saturated or hazardous footprint or a person on it pause before any charge (branch-screen-paused); assemble or repair naming the screen resumes after the rechecks (branch-screen-resumed); a lost reserved unit stops the work (branch-screen-failed). Cancel (no energy) returns uninstalled units once; death leaves them where the person died; installed pieces stay as an incomplete screen. Inspect (target in reach; 1 round, 0.2 energy) reports installed, missing and loose pieces, integrity, porosity, current wind and rain, facing, the shield the rule gives now and lee-floor occupants (branch-screen-inspected, unverified record; nothing repaired). Repair (builder only; target, components: installed piece ids, materials: the same number of units) pays one removal and one fitting round per piece and a check round at 1.5 energy each; removed pieces become unowned ground debris at their place with condition, mass and provenance; components [] only reruns the check; it needs a fully installed screen (branch-screen-repaired, then completed or check-failed). Dismantle (builder only; 1 round, 1 energy) removes up to three pieces per round, rods before uprights, to the ground with their condition, and the object disappears with the last group (branch-screen-dismantled). No energy, time or damage is refunded. Effect: through a physiology hook outermost in forestPhysiology, a complete screen removes min(0.35, solid share of its sound pieces) x facing of the wind part (exposure x wind) of the existing outdoor chill for a living person whose whole body circle lies on the lee floor, 0.45-1.35 m behind the line and within its 0.9 m width (branch-screen-exposure-measured); rain chill, air temperature, hunger, energy and rest are unchanged; nothing applies in wind above 0.8, indoors, when a roofed shelter applies or when another shelter rule already changed that round's exposure, and copies never stack. Weather wear per round on installed pieces is the reused ex11/ex15 law 0.0005 + 0.002 x rain + 0.002 x wind; a rod below 0.5 no longer counts toward the solid share (branch-screen-deteriorated), an upright below 0.5 makes a complete screen damaged with no shielding until repair and a passing check (branch-screen-damaged). Installed pieces make the thin 0.06 x 0.9 m line solid for passage. The completion event carries no qualified flag, so no practice milestone is awarded, records are unverified (no information-confirmed event; the existing information-gain rule is bound to probe and does not apply), and no satisfaction, comfort or reward source is added. Modeling assumptions: the world gives a fallen-branch unit no length, diameter, straightness or point, so, as in ex15 simple-shelter@1, one whole untreated branch unit (1.1 mass units) is one piece of the declared size (uprights 0.7 m x 2.5 cm, rods 1.1 m x 1.5 cm); the recipe is therefore 11 units (12.1 mass units, 22 gather energy), dimensions are declared rather than measured, and the mass per piece is larger than a real stick of that size. Hand insertion works only in ordinary soil with waterlogging at most 0.1 and no hazard (the ex15 shelter and long-planting-site hand-work rule); forest floor, wet bank, dry hard ground and water refuse it; insertion depth is the declared 0.25 m and there is no stiffness model, so no numeric displacement is computed: the low-force check counts loose pieces against condition 0.5 (the ex15 sound condition) and uses the probe-revealed branch strength (0.3, ex15's load threshold) and flexibility (0.2) values; flexibility 0.2 is taken as sufficient for a gentle open weave in which each rod deflects about one upright thickness over the 0.45 m spacing (ex15 requires 0.7 only for wrapped binding), and fit and spring-back are not represented separately; a post below condition 0.5 breaks under the push. The solid share is the projected area of the sound rods and uprights over the 0.9 x 0.4 m woven face (about 0.36, porosity about 0.64), and the wind reduction on the lee floor equals that share capped at the existing 0.35 maximum wind shield of simple-shelter@1, a first-order porous-barrier approximation; the lee floor spans one to three screen heights behind the line, beyond the 0.45 m fall reach, and only the screen's width, because a short screen gives little shelter past its ends; people are 0.22 m circles without posture, so the rule presumes a body resting low on the ground. World wind has speed but no direction: the only direction the existing exposure physics represents is the +x convention of the ex10 refuge and ex15 shelters, so orientation 0 faces it and facing is cos(orientation); wind shifts cannot occur, which the ability states. The ex15 light-weather wind limit (0.8) withholds shielding. Loose pieces stay installed rather than falling. The world has no place ownership or access permissions, so none is checked or granted. Grounded: real branch units, escrow, mass and provenance, energy and round costs, ground conditions, material values, current wind and rain, the existing exposure chill and body-temperature update, and the existing wear law. Not grounded (declared or approximated): piece dimensions, the 0.25 m insertion, the flexibility threshold, the porosity-to-shield relation, the lee floor extent, the +x wind direction, and the absence of a displacement model. Reuse: ex15 simple-shelter@1's sound condition, wear law, light-weather wind limit, largest wind shield and the staged paid-assembly, install, release, pause, cancel and death pattern (constants imported or re-declared; ex15 code unchanged and ex7-ex15 replay compatibility identical); collective-work.ts escrow and paid work; material-lots.ts; open-physical.ts; forest-climate.ts; open-foundation.ts personal records; unchanged base gather and rest. New files long-branch-screen.ts and long-branch-screen-exposure.ts; the hook is added in forest-environment.ts and returns the incoming value unless branch-screen@1 is installed; a small branch-screen drawing is added to continuous-visuals.ts (dashed plan line, installed uprights and woven rods only, grey when loose, no shielding drawn) because the ex15 lean-to drawing assumes a roof. Tests cover scope, learning, the size limit and excluded vocabulary, assessment and post-trial costs and outcomes (including an informative failure and breakage), cost-free refusals (no trial, wrong recipe, out of reach, occupied footprint, low energy, wet bank), the 8 paid rounds and 12 energy, conservation and carried load, the drawing, wind-only shielding with the exact temperature change, facing, lee-floor bounds and the wind limit, pause and resume, cancel, builder-only repair and dismantle, inspection, wear to a loose rod and a loose upright, exact repair, a failed check and its rerun, dismantling in groups of three and death.

Reviewed Moss's round-22 request (weave-grass-mat: make a small portable sitting mat by physically working suitable gathered dry grass, if that material can support it; a dry grass source seen at (14.2, 16.3), nothing gathered or tested, costs unknown, durability and any comfort only under an explicit physical contract and trial, no guaranteed belonging or responses) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 3): a general hand-weave-fiber-mat(target, materials, mode, position) operation for any learner and suitable fibrous plant material with modes test, assemble/resume, inspect, trial, repair, place, dismantle and cancel, producing one unbacked hand-plaited 0.45 x 0.45 m portable sitting mat from exactly 4 gathered units after a 0.1-unit material test, with a 0.5-energy layout, six 1-energy paid rounds ending in a lift-and-integrity check, wear of 0.0005 per exposed round and 0.002 per occupied round, a +0.5 physical-comfort contribution only while sitting on a dry intact mat that passed a trial, and no thermal, rain, wind, medical, nutrition or automatic response effect. The specification is self-consistent and every part except the comfort term and moisture has an honest basis in the world, so this is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release. Implemented hand-weave-fiber-mat@1 in scope long-ex16 (learning 3; the ability serializes to 3,461 code units, within the 3,500 limit) in packages/world-core/src/long-fiber-mat.ts. Test (sample: an owned unreserved stack of at least 0.1; 1 round, 0.5 energy, the probe trial cost) splits exactly 0.1 off into an owned, identified tested-scrap stack of the same resource, origin and age, so nothing disappears, and reports the probe-revealed flexibility and strength, brittleness, sample condition, whether strips form and whether a tucked edge is retained; it passes only for untreated thin grass-like stems (dry grass, reeds) with flexibility at least 0.4 and an intact sample (condition at least 0.5); roots, branches, moss and other materials fail with the measured reason; the result is stored per resource and source with the sample id and tick (a retest replaces it) as a verified personal record (fiber-mat-tested; its information-confirmed event carries this interface, so the probe-bound grounded-understanding rule does not apply). Assemble (x, y and materials: exactly 4.0 owned units, in 0.1 steps, of one stem fiber whose resource and source a passing test by the same person covers; fresh units, earlier offcuts, recovered fiber or scraps of that source may be combined) requires mastery, a clear 0.45 m square in reach (inside the world, not over water, overlapping no plant, object, site or entrance and no other living person) and 0.5 energy; it reserves the units through collective-work escrow with exact source provenance (still carried, owned and counted as load; fiber-mat-started), creates the workpiece object and pays the layout round (0.5 energy), which sums the actual intact fiber mass (quantity x resource mass x intact share) against the declared requirement: a shortfall stops the work, returns every reserved tenth once and makes no mat (fiber-mat-shortfall, with the measured shortfall); otherwise six paid rounds of 1 energy follow (two strip-forming rounds that move 2 and then the remaining 2 units from escrow into the workpiece with identity, origin and age, two interlacing rounds, one edge-tucking round and the lift check; fiber-mat-layout and fiber-mat-progress record each round once), continuing each round, 6.5 energy in all. The lift check keeps exactly the needed tenths, most intact first (3.7 units of dry grass, 0.37 mass), returns the rest to the weaver as owned offcuts (intact share at least 0.5) or scraps, so input = fiber in the mat + offcuts + scraps, and passes only with full fiber and condition at least 0.5, i.e. a largest opening of 0.06 x (1 - condition) m of at most 0.03 m (fiber-mat-completed); otherwise the mat stays failed and unusable (fiber-mat-check-failed). An unworked round, too little energy, leaving reach or another person on the square pause before any charge (fiber-mat-paused); assemble or repair naming the mat resumes after the rechecks at the recorded unpaid round (fiber-mat-resumed); lost reserved fiber stops the work (fiber-mat-failed). Cancel (no energy) returns unincorporated fiber once and leaves incorporated fiber as a loose workpiece at the square, which cannot be lifted or sat on and can be dismantled (fiber-mat-cancelled); death stops the work and drops reserved fiber where the person died, and a carried mat is laid down there as the same mat. reviews.specification: Development handoff in this conversation: implement 'Hand-break food', parameterized by mode (trial, prepare, inspect, cancel), owned input stack ID, whole-unit quantity and optional work ID. Dependencies: an explicit deterministic hand-workability rule using material resistance, represented geometry and available hand force; processed-food lot support preserving nutrition, toxicity, origin and age; and persistent work/event records. If these mechanisms are missing, implement them in this handoff. Do not silently assign every edible material a successful result. For existing roots, author a conservative material response from the actual implementation facts; if those facts do not support hand-breaking, the executable outcome is an informative failed trial, not invented pieces or a cooking unlock. No implementation or review waiting advances time. Prerequisites: individual study completed, usable hands, reachable owned edible food, sufficient energy, and no concurrent reservation of the same units. No tools, heat, water, vessel or work surface is supplied or required for an in-hand attempt. This is not washing, sterilization, detoxification, peeling or cooking. Wren may target item-183-wren-2083 or item-111-wren-1316 only if still owned, accessible and eligible under their actual current food state; the older lot's displayed decay value alone does not establish safety. Never expose hidden spoilage or material values. Trial accepts one whole unit, costs one active round and 1 energy, and applies bounded hand force once while holding the food. Its physical result persists: if it fractures, retain the same edible quantity as a coarse-piece lot; if it does not, retain the intact or visibly deformed lot. Record observed resistance, fracture or deformation, not an unsupported safety conclusion. Prepare applies the same operation to each selected unit, one round and 1 energy per unit, retaining completed units individually. A prior trial is optional, not a separate mandatory assessment activity. Inspect costs one round and 0.2 energy and reports only observable form, quantity, work stage and visible deterioration; cancel takes no work energy and terminates unfinished work. Recheck prerequisites before each paid round; validation failures spend no work energy or ingredients. Reference inputs by stable item IDs and work by stable work IDs, never resource-name substitution. Reserve rather than duplicate input units. Each completed unit is atomically transferred to an output lot with its original owner, source, harvest age, decay state, nutrition and toxicity. Represent coarse pieces as the same food quantity with changed form, not several new nutrition-bearing units. For a root unit, retain its applicable existing nutrition of 14 before existing deterioration rules, not 14 per fragment; no bonus calories, lower toxicity, freshness reset or keeping-quality improvement. Any detached inedible or spoiled portion must remain accounted for as waste with its associated mass and nutritional share, never disappear or become free food. Cancellation releases unworked reserved food once and leaves completed outputs unchanged. Death leaves surviving inputs and outputs at the death location under existing possession rules, with no duplication. Lost or spoiled inputs cannot be replaced for free. Paid effort is never refunded; unspent energy was never debited. No autonomous production, fire or other ongoing process continues after a step. Products need no special maintenance beyond ordinary handling and existing spoilage rules; no preservation effect is added. Do not grant inventory, consent, mastery, permissions or a change to protected reward accounts, goals or budgets.
